q: Where was the Holy Piby, an early “Black man's Bible”, first published?
explain: Robert Athlyi Rogers published it in Newark in 1924. It later shaped the preaching of Leonard Howell.

q: What does Grounation Day (21 April) commemorate?
explain: A vast crowd met Haile Selassie at Palisadoes airport on 21 April 1966.

q: Which Mansion assigns members to a tribe of Israel by birth month?
explain: Founded by Vernon Carrington in 1968, the Twelve Tribes links each member to a tribe by birth month.

q: Which drum keeps the steady heartbeat in Nyabinghi drumming?
explain: The funde plays a steady two-stroke heartbeat; the repeater improvises above it.

q: What happened at Coral Gardens in 1963?
options: A mass crackdown on Rastas by the Jamaican state
The founding of the Bobo Shanti
explain: Rastas across Jamaica were rounded up, beaten and forcibly shaved. The government apologised in 2017.

q: Where in Ethiopia did Haile Selassie grant land to the diaspora?
explain: 500 acres at Shashamane were granted in 1948.
